newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Community College #512, Ill.

text.p: (Counties of Cook, Kane, Lake and McHenry and State of
Separate sealed bids for the bonds will be received

until 10:00 A.M. C.D.T., Thursday, October 24, 1996 at the office of Kane, McKenna Capital, Inc., 150 North Wacker Drive, Suite 1600, Chicago, Illinois, for the above bonds dated November 1, 1996 and maturing December 1, 1997- 2006, inclusive. The Bonds are callable on December 1 2003 and thereafter in the manner provided in the Official Notice of Sale. The District will designate the Bonds as

issuer exemption provided by Section 265(b)(3) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986. The Bonds will be issued in book-entry form only, in the form of one certificate for the aggregate principal amount of the Bonds maturing in each year. The District will furnish the bonds with CUSIP numbers printed thereon and the approving legal opinion of Chapman and Cutler, Chicago, Illinois. All bids must be for all bonds at a price of not less than 99% plus accrued interest. Bid forms, together with the Official Statement and Official Notice of Sale, may be obtained from:
